game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the vine bridge using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The vine bridge reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the vine bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
